root_causes.ISS-043: SessionResultResponse lacked a status field; frontend isPending check (score_pct === null) missed grading_pending sessions with score_pct = 0
root_causes.ISS-044: isPending was false for grading_pending sessions with score_pct = 0, so canRetake={isPending ? false : canRetake} guard did not suppress the retake button
root_causes.ISS-045: GetQuestionBreakdown SQL did not SELECT sqs.manual_feedback; questionBreakdownRow, QuestionBreakdownItem (Go and TS), and QuestionBreakdownTable all lacked the manual_feedback field

fix_descriptions.ISS-043: Added Status field to SessionResultResponse (backend model + service); added status to SessionResult TS type; updated isPending to check status === 'grading_pending'
fix_descriptions.ISS-044: Fixed by ISS-043 fix — isPending now correctly true for grading_pending, suppressing canRetake via existing guard
fix_descriptions.ISS-045: Added sqs.manual_feedback to GetQuestionBreakdown SQL; added ManualFeedback to questionBreakdownRow and QuestionBreakdownItem (Go); propagated in buildSessionResult; added manual_feedback to TS type and rendered Examiner Feedback column in QuestionBreakdownTable; added i18n keys
